name: Double-bus single-breaker bay arrangement
summary: Provides the assigned bay with selected connection paths to two buses through one circuit breaker.
description: Provides the assigned bay with selected connection paths to two buses through one circuit breaker. A busbar arrangement defines the available paths between incoming circuits, outgoing circuits and bus sections. Its switching devices and measurement boundaries determine how a circuit can remain connected when part of the installation is unavailable.

In a switchyard, a single-line arrangement helps identify the bay connections, tie devices and possible alternate supply paths. Normal open points must remain separate from the equipment's physical ability to close. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two bus choices” at the input and “Selected bay bus connection” at the output. Bus selection depends on the disconnector arrangement.

Name each bus, bay and switching device. The arrangement illustrates electrical connectivity; reliability, fault levels, permitted switching and protection coordination require the actual network design. The circuit arrangement is an independent explanation of this named application.
